name: Chill Touch
summary: A cantrip melee spell attack that deals Necrotic damage and stops the target from regaining Hit Points.

stats.effect: Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} until the end of your next turn.
stats.cantripUpgrade: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).
